dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: As you can see, this is just a remote little town that makes its living from ice mining.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: If you're looking to earn some extra Mora with odd jobs, you can speak with Supervisor Sobolev. But if you're thinking of taking up ice mining long-term, you'll probably need to ask Pashkov first.
